verifiable-quality-gates.why: the harness is itself a check proven to detect: reverting the #142 invoke fix makes it fail with 'gate arch-gate FAILED on the vendoring consumer', and the #119 vacuity guard proves a failing child node --test is caught once NODE_TEST_CONTEXT is stripped
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added test/vendored-consumer-harness.test.mjs that runs the scaffolded gates on a vendoring consumer and asserts each exits 0; proved it discriminates by reverting #142 and observing the failure, then restored
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

architectural-decision-records.why: the vendored-consumer harness design (what it runs, the representative-test scoping, the offline-provenance self-copy, the #119 stripping) is architecturally significant and recorded in one ADR
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0073 documenting the harness, the discrimination proof, and the honest limits
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: a vendoring-topology break can only be caught by an end-to-end integration test that builds the real layout and runs the scaffolded gates, so the test type matches the risk
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: an integration harness that git-inits a consumer, vendors the skills, runs esk-genesis, and runs every gate
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug, and match the test type to the risk.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the vendoring-consumer scenario and the non-happy vacuity path (a failing child test must be detected) are enumerated and committed as executable tests
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: two node:test cases: the full vendoring-consumer gate run, and the NODE_TEST_CONTEXT-strip vacuity guard
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the honest limits: ALL gates run but only one representative discrimination test runs nested (host feasibility), and the offline-provenance self-copy tests vendoring-green not the release round-trip (which manifest-provenance.test.mjs covers)
skeptical-audit.what: recorded the limits and the discrimination proof in ADR-0073 rather than overclaiming the harness exercises every nested test
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: a fresh-context review was run on the harness delta (diffed against the PR1 branch) before the PR, scrutinizing discrimination, the #119 strip, and the provenance self-copy
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in a fresh subagent and recorded it in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

pattern-selector.why: no new feature, class, module or data flow; this is an integration test that drives the existing installer and gates

arch-encode.why: this IS the prevent-by-construction guard for the consumer-install class, enforced as a test, not a new rules-file entry

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no PII, retention, migration, backup or audit logic; this is test infrastructure on throwaway temp dirs

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, database or integration architecture changed; this is a CI harness

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no input, auth, session, crypto, upload or dependency surface changed; the harness spawns node/git on temp dirs it creates

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, feature-flag or rollback mechanism changed; repo-self test, no version bump

sre-operational-readiness.why: no SLI/SLO, alert, runbook or production-operability surface changed

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing or UI surface; developer-facing test infrastructure

universal-browser-device-support.why: no frontend or browser-facing code; developer-facing test infrastructure

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing flow, screen, form or copy; developer-facing test infrastructure
